name: Dograh
description: Builds and self-hosts voice AI agents with a visual workflow builder, telephony, and bring-your-own-key speech-to-speech or LLM, STT, and TTS pipelines.

skills.name: Voice Pipeline
skills.description: Assembles STT, LLM, and TTS stages or a single speech-to-speech model into a low-latency conversational voice loop.

skills.name: Telephony Routing
skills.description: Places and receives phone calls through connected telephony providers, routing them into agent workflows.

skills.name: Visual Workflow Builder
skills.description: Defines call flows, branching logic, and tool calls on a visual canvas that runs as the live agent.
